name: Fichtes Restaurant & Bar
kurzbeschreibung:
**Fichtes Restaurant & Bar in Riezlern**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the **Allgäu Alps**, where **Fichtes Restaurant & Bar** invites you to savor traditional flavors in a cozy mountain setting. Just steps from the slopes of **Riezlern**, this charming spot offers hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, and fresh **Käseknödel**, paired with local craft beers and fine wines.

Whether you're craving a warm **Apfelstrudel** after a day of skiing or a refreshing **Radler** on the terrace, **Fichtes** blends rustic charm with modern comfort. A perfect retreat for food lovers and outdoor enthusiasts alike—just a short drive from **Innsbruck** and the stunning **Lech Valley**.
